report.summary: Checkout timeouts on UPI pay occurred due to an external latency and error rate spike in partner-bank-api starting at 13:41. This caused upi-gateway worker pools to exhaust as requests blocked waiting on partner-bank-api, leading to upi-gateway latency spikes and timeouts that subsequently cascaded into payments-api and mobile-bff error rates.

supporting.note: Shows the earliest anomaly onset at 13:41 preceding all other service latencies.
Shows upi-gateway latency rising immediately after partner-bank-api at 13:43.
Shows upi-gateway worker pool exhaustion with workers waiting on partner-bank-api.
Shows payments-api latency jumping at 13:45 mirroring downstream delays.

ranked_hypotheses.title: UPI Gateway Worker Pool Concurrency Bottleneck

supporting.note: Confirms worker pool exhaustion (200/200 busy) on upi-gateway.

contradicting.note: Partner-bank-api latency started rising at 13:41, whereas upi-gateway metrics only started rising at 13:43, proving the fault originated upstream.

facts.text: partner-bank-api latency_p99_ms showed an anomaly starting upward from 13:41, reaching a peak of 9237.07 ms at 14:01.
upi-gateway latency_p99_ms showed an anomaly starting upward from 13:43.
payments-api latency_p99_ms showed an anomaly starting upward from 13:45, reaching a peak of 10772.92 ms at 13:55.
partner-bank-api error_rate_pct showed an anomaly starting upward from 13:45, reaching a peak of 4.56% at 13:49.
payments-api logs showed continuous 10000ms timeouts calling upi-gateway POST /v2/collect beginning at 13:46:00.
upi-gateway error_rate_pct showed an anomaly starting upward from 13:46.
payments-api error_rate_pct showed an anomaly starting upward from 13:47.
mobile-bff error_rate_pct showed an anomaly starting upward from 13:47.
upi-gateway experienced worker pool exhaustion (200/200 busy), rejecting requests with most workers waiting on partner-bank-api starting at 13:47.
fraud-service velocity threshold configuration was raised from 5 to 7 transactions/min at 2026-10-04T13:30:00+00:00.

assumptions: The root cause inside partner-bank-api is entirely external and outside internal system logs.

timeline.event: fraud-service velocity threshold configuration raised from 5 to 7 transactions/min
payments-api latency_p99_ms and partner-bank-api error_rate_pct begin anomaly rises
payments-api logs timeouts calling upi-gateway; upi-gateway error_rate_pct begins rising
upi-gateway worker pool exhausted; payments-api and mobile-bff error rates begin rising

recommended_actions.action: Coordinate with the external partner-bank-api provider to investigate their latency spike and error rates.
recommended_actions.rationale: partner-bank-api is the upstream origin of the latency and failure chain.

recommended_actions.action: Implement circuit breakers and aggressive request shedding on upi-gateway for calls to partner-bank-api.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents upi-gateway worker pool exhaustion and cascading failures to payments-api when partner-bank-api degrades.

recommended_actions.action: Establish secondary redundant payment routes or fallback partner banks for UPI transactions.
recommended_actions.rationale: Mitigates single-vendor external dependencies causing total feature degradation.
